analysis.session_summary: The overnight NY afternoon-to-Asia window was catalyst-light: most zigzag legs carried no clear driver and were attributed to flow or technical levels. Risk appetite firmed, with SPX +0.177%, VIX -0.359%, and Brent +2.206%, while DXY slipped -0.059%. NZD led majors at +0.245%, GBP gained +0.063%, CHF +0.060%, while AUD (-0.130%) and JPY (-0.115%) lagged. EUR/USD closed +8.3 pips at 1.14777 after chopping inside a 15.9-pip range, and the only measured event reaction was RBA Gov Bullock Speaks, which lifted AUD 0.066% but was unscored for surprise.

themes.theme: Broad USD softness with selective strength
themes.evidence: DXY/USD fell -0.059%, USD/CHF -10.4 pips, USD/CAD -6.3 pips, but USD/JPY rose +4.6 pips.
NZD +0.245% versus AUD -0.130%; AUD/NZD closed -40.8 pips at 1.24128 near session lows.
Most legs in EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, USD/CHF, USD/CAD had no clear catalyst and were attributed to flow or technical levels.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: Six alternating legs moved the pair within a 15.9-pip range, with the largest 14.5-pip up-leg into 06:45, closing +8.3 pips at 1.14777 near the high.
leg_notes.GBP/USD: GBP/USD traced a 26.8-pip range across four legs, with a 23.5-pip up-leg into 06:45, closing +17.2 pips at 1.33866.
leg_notes.AUD/USD: AUD/USD fell 21.5 pips into 03:30 then rebounded 19.0 pips into 06:45, closing -2.8 pips at 0.71208 inside its 27.5-pip range.
leg_notes.NZD/USD: NZD/USD fell 22.5 pips into 03:00 then rallied 39.4 pips into 06:45, closing +16.5 pips at 0.57362 near the high of a 45.2-pip range.
leg_notes.USD/JPY: USD/JPY chopped through seven alternating legs in a 32.7-pip range, closing +4.6 pips at 157.461 in the upper part of the range with no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.USD/CHF: USD/CHF moved lower in three of five legs, closing -10.4 pips at 0.82004 at the bottom of a 16.1-pip range.
leg_notes.USD/CAD: USD/CAD alternated in an 18.7-pip range with two up and two down legs, closing -6.3 pips at 1.40249 near session lows.
leg_notes.EUR/CHF: EUR/CHF chopped in a narrow 9.6-pip range, closing -5.2 pips at 0.94121; RBA Gov Bullock was only a minor contributor to one up-leg.
leg_notes.CHF/JPY: CHF/JPY dropped 39.1 pips into 23:00 then rallied 63.9 pips into 06:45, closing +27.9 pips at 192.028 near highs.
leg_notes.AUD/NZD: AUD/NZD rose 32.2 pips into 03:00 then reversed down 73.3 pips into 06:45, closing -40.8 pips at 1.24128 near the lows.
leg_notes.EUR/GBP: EUR/GBP traded an 8.0-pip range across three legs, closing -4.9 pips at 0.85737 with no clear driver.
leg_notes.AUD/CHF: AUD/CHF fell 17.4 pips into 03:30, retraced 15.1 pips, then slipped again to close -9.9 pips at 0.58392.
leg_notes.NZD/CHF: NZD/CHF fell 19.7 pips into 03:00 then rallied 27.9 pips into 06:45, closing +7.6 pips at 0.47038 near highs.

polarity_reads.read: Unscored because no forecast was available; the measured own-currency impulse was +0.066% with NZD/USD the top mover at +0.086%, suggesting no inverted reaction in AUD.

scenarios.name: Risk-on extension, USD soft
scenarios.thesis: Overnight tape shows DXY/USD -0.059%, SPX/USD +0.177%, VIX/USD -0.359%, and Brent/USD +2.206%; continued risk appetite should favor high-beta FX and oil-sensitive currencies while yen lags.
scenarios.invalidation: DXY/USD recaptures 100.03371 and USD/JPY breaks below 157.461, signaling risk-off safety demand.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD closed +8.3 pips at 1.14777 near the top of its 15.9-pip range; a soft USD could keep it bid toward the range top.
NZD was the strongest major at +0.245% and NZD/USD closed +16.5 pips at 0.57362 near highs within a 45.2-pip range.
JPY was the weakest major at -0.115%; USD/JPY closed +4.6 pips at 157.461 inside a 32.7-pip range, and risk-on can lift it further.

scenarios.name: Consolidation around overnight ranges
scenarios.thesis: Most legs lacked clear catalysts and several USD pairs closed mid-range, pointing to two-way flow; without a fresh impulse, prices may stay inside the measured overnight ranges.
scenarios.invalidation: A decisive break of EUR/USD above 1.14777 or below its overnight low on above-normal volume.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD chopped in six alternating legs and closed at 1.14777 near the top of a 15.9-pip range with no clear driver.
GBP/USD spanned a 26.8-pip range across four legs and closed +17.2 pips at 1.33866 near the high.
USD/JPY traded seven alternating legs, closing +4.6 pips at 157.461 in the upper part of a 32.7-pip range.

scenarios.name: USD/JPY short-covering bounce
scenarios.thesis: Despite broad USD softness, JPY was the weakest major and USD/JPY closed higher; if positioning rebalances ahead of Lagarde or on hawkish Fed rhetoric, USD/JPY has room to extend.
triggers: No immediate break below the USD/JPY overnight low
scenarios.invalidation: USD/JPY falls below 157.461 and breaks the low of the 32.7-pip range, confirming renewed JPY strength.

pair_paths.rationale: JPY was the weakest at -0.115%; USD/JPY closed +4.6 pips at 157.461 with a measured 32.7-pip range.
USD/CHF closed -10.4 pips at 0.82004 at the bottom of a 16.1-pip range; a USD rebound could lift it within that range.
EUR/USD is near the top of its 15.9-pip range after closing +8.3 pips; a USD bounce would pressure it back toward range lows.

risks.why_it_matters: Brent/USD rose 2.206% to 104.037 and is a key risk-on driver; a sharp drop could unwind NZD/GBP strength and lift USD/JPY.
risks.watch: Brent/USD close versus 104.037 and a break of the 351.4-pip range

risks.why_it_matters: AUD was the weakest major at -0.130% despite a +0.066% impulse on RBA Gov Bullock Speaks; if markets reprice RBA, AUD/USD and AUD/NZD could extend their moves.
ECB President Lagarde speaks at 13:00; comments on the energy shock or policy path can break EUR/USD and EUR/CHF out of their narrow ranges.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: ECB President Lagarde Speaks at 13:00 is the next scheduled event; it can shift EUR/USD, EUR/CHF, and EUR/GBP if she comments on the energy shock or monetary policy path. Until then, the tape may remain flow-driven inside the overnight ranges.
